text:
Iron nails are stored in an airtight container.
lid
air
iron nails
The nails begin to rust after a few days.
How can the rusting of the nails be prevented?
A
Leave the lid off.
B
Replace the air with argon.
C
Put the container in a warm place.
D
Seal the container in a bag.

options.label: C
options.text: Put the container in a warm place.

options.label: D
options.text: Seal the container in a bag.
